title: Monthly Girls' Nozaki-kun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chiyo Sakura confesses to her classmate Umetarou Nozaki, who mistakes her for a fan and gives her an autograph: he is secretly a popular shoujo manga artist. She becomes his assistant, and their quirky friends, a princely girl, a shy flirt and a blunt singer among them, unknowingly inspire his romance comic. Yen Press publishes it in English; rating to verify.
life_message: It holds up friendship, creative work and laughing at the clichés we expect of romance and gender.
